situation: A family sits in a living room in the evening, watching a glowing electronic screen mounted in a wooden cabinet.
subject: the television
brief: A bulky vintage television set sits prominently on a low wooden stand in a dimly lit living room, casting a bright blue and white flicker across the walls. The glowing glass screen dominates the frame, showing abstract shapes of broadcast programmes, while the rest of the room remains in comfortable shadow.
prompt: A bulky vintage television set sits prominently on a low wooden stand in a dimly lit living room, casting a bright blue and white flicker across the walls. The glowing glass screen dominates the frame, showing abstract shapes of broadcast programmes, while the rest of the room remains in comfortable shadow. a 1970s science-fiction paperback cover, airbrushed gradients, a muted offset-print palette with visible halftone, dramatic scale and a confident optimistic mood. It renders an ordinary modern scene as though it were the future someone once imagined, so it suits machinery, travel, work and plans as readily as spacecraft. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
